name: Twin Minaret Masjid
summary: A broad, quiet mosque joins a flowing central dome, twin minarets, and one generous doorway.
why: The dome and doorway share the same centerline. Mirrored minarets meet one continuous prayer hall and share its foundation. Attached brass crowns give the architecture a restrained finish.
risk: The familiar mosque silhouette prioritizes clarity and proportion over a novel symbol.
reasonToChoose: You want a clear mosque identity with no extra symbolism.
